profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: For more information, visit my website: radfordparker.com

positions.title: Principal Scientist
positions.description:
-Working in the Mixed Reality organization on topics like anchoring, localization, and mapping for real-time augmented reality applications
-Developing cross-platform SDKs that run on HoloLens 2, iOS (ARKit), and Android (ARCore) devices

positions.title: Vice President, Research and Core Development
positions.description:
−Led a team that focused on real-time graphics, camera calibration, camera registration, feature recognition, feature tracking, object detection, sensor fusion, bundle adjustment, real-time camera tracking, video stabilization, lidar scanning, and 3D reconstruction
−Built libraries, applications, and 3D models that have been utilized for live events in tennis, golf, football, baseball, hockey, and American football
−Led the team that created the most accurate system in the world for making offside decisions in football
−Led the team that built the first system to track a fully articulating camera in real-time for live broadcast quality augmented reality using only monocular vision

positions.title: Computer Vision Engineer
positions.description:
-Worked with artists to design, build, and integrate tools into a production environment
-Projects focused on the topics of machine learning, image segmentation, and feature detection
-Major projects concentrated on building complete pipelines for automated offline tree detection and interactive region masking from high resolution aerial imagery

positions.title: Project Associate Development Engineer
positions.description:
-Worked on a research and development team with projects that focused on augmented reality, optical character recognition, tracking, segmentation, numerical optimization, and pose estimation
-Major projects concentrated on real-time camera tracking, augmented reality, free viewpoint video, broadcast video game state detection, and automated highlight generation

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
-Worked under the guidance of Irfan Essa on video segmentation and RGB-D research
-Projects included depth inpainting and video segmentation enhanced with depth and occlusion features

positions.title: Lead Developer, Computer Vision System
positions.description:
-Developed automated object segmentation algorithm for assisted stereo 3D rotoscoping
-Work focused on topics revolving around alpha matting, video segmentation, pose estimation, and region tracking
